summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting Q1 2026 results and announcing the acquisition of Boralex, a global listed renewable platform. Terms (price, premium, implied value) are not disclosed in the excerpt. The acquisition complements Brookfield's existing operations with a large operating base and de-risked development pipeline. CEO Connor Teskey highlighted the deal as a growth accelerator. No board recommendation or advisors named. Structural notes: First quarter record FFO of $375M. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals; risk-arb focus on integration execution and potential shareholder dilution.
